instructions: To perform an action use 'verb noun' e.g. 'take item', 'open door'.
To move use a direction e.g. 'north', 'southeast' or short verions e.g. 'n', 'se'.
To see information on a room use 'look'.
To see information on an item use 'describe' or 'examine' e.g. 'describe book'.
To see what you are carrying use command 'inventory'.
